video.title: Meet Abdulkaiz: how I design and build

story:
I'm a design engineer from Gujarat, India with a Computer Science degree. UI/UX comes first, then the build. I work in Framer, Webflow, WordPress and Wix, and go custom when the tool gets in the way.

I've done product design at Mastercard and data visualization at Nixtla, and since 2018 I've built open-source software on GitHub as @ful1e5. My designs reach over 500K users, and the number keeps growing.

I use Figma, Claude, MCP and whatever ships fastest. Message me "Hi." No form, no brief, no 12-slide deck.
bio:
Abdulkaiz Khatri is a design engineer who treats interface design and engineering as one discipline. With a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science from Gujarat Technological University and years of hands-on product work, he designs the experience first and then builds it, so what is approved in Figma is what ships.

His work spans websites, landing pages, web apps and mobile interfaces, built in Framer, Webflow, WordPress and Wix, or in custom code when a tool becomes the constraint. He pairs a conversion-minded UX process of wireframes and prototypes with clean, fast front-end engineering and workflow automation that removes repetitive work for small teams.

Since 2018 he has also built open-source software as @ful1e5, supported through GitHub Sponsors. Products he has designed and shipped reach more than 500K users, and that number keeps growing.

Abdulkaiz works directly with founders and small business owners: clear scope, steady updates and a build that is fast by default.
